description: An open field of grass, wheat or wildflowers under a low sun, with a soft treeline on the horizon. Warm and quiet: vehicles, furniture and outdoor products. timeOfDay dawn, golden, dusk or overcast sets the sun's height and colour; sunAzimuthDeg turns the sun around the subject (0 = behind it, a rim, seen from the hero camera; 90 = from the camera's right). grassHeightM sets the crop height (a clearing keeps the subject visible); track adds a flattened dirt track along the subject's long axis for a drive.
